units.source_text: 盒饭尽管难吃，他还是专心地吃。

en.t: Although the boxed lunch tasted bad, he still ate it with concentration.

units.source_text: 他的盒饭质量低，可是也不低于我早餐时自备的盒饭。

en.t: His boxed lunch was poor in quality, but it was no worse than the one I had prepared for my own breakfast.

units.source_text: 1945年那年月，如果不靠黑市食物是摄取不到营养的。

en.t: In those days of 1945, it was impossible to get enough nutrition without relying on black-market food.
